title: Broccoli Tree Scribe
description: A woman in a green dress with an exposed anatomical heart sits at a wooden desk writing in an open book. Behind her grows an enormous surreal broccoli tree with multiple screaming faces emerging from its stalks, flowing like banners over a miniature city with red spires.
prompt: Surreal scene of a woman with long dark hair wearing a green dress and white sleeves, an exposed red anatomical heart visible on her chest, sitting at a wooden desk writing in a book with a quill. Behind her stands a giant vibrant green broccoli tree with multiple screaming human faces flowing out from its stalks like banners. Below the tree is a miniature city with red spires. The background wall is purple with framed anatomical diagrams, the upper background is textured orange. Whimsical dark fantasy style.
